title: Which Crimes Could Trump and His Allies *Actually* Be Prosecuted For? Legal Expert Explains
author: John Harwood
content:
_" If we lose the midterms, and we lose 2028, some in this room are going to
prison, myself included."_

That was former Trump adviser [Steve
Bannon](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DQwCngIFX_l/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=NTc4MTIwNjQ2YQ==),
speaking at a conservative event last year. But is he right? When Donald Trump
eventually leaves power, will his allies walk free, or face a legal reckoning?
And can presidential immunity shield him forever?

The answer, former federal prosecutor **Joyce Vance** tells **Zeteo 's John
Harwood**, is complicated.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Watch the**full video above** to hear Vance break down who could realistically
face prosecution for some of the Trump administration's most serious crimes:
from Pete Hegseth's military strikes on [boats in the
Caribbean](https://zeteo.com/p/second-strike-all-of-the-us-strikes), to the
ICE and DHS killings of U.S. citizens [Renee Good](https://zeteo.com/p/ice-
immunity-renee-good-rocah) and [Alex Pretti](https://zeteo.com/p/dhs-shooting-
victim-in-minneapolis) in Minneapolis.
